title: Which Friends character are you? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Friends quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Rachel, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler or Ross. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
lede: Organized like Monica, sarcastic like Chandler or wonderfully weird like Phoebe? Answer 12 questions about your apartment, your dates and your coffee order to find your Friends match.
about: Friends followed six twenty-somethings in New York through ten seasons of jobs, dates and long afternoons at Central Perk. It still finds new fans because everyone recognizes someone in the group: Rachel's style and growing independence, Monica's need for order and competitive streak, Phoebe's free spirit and odd songs, Joey's big heart and bigger appetite, Chandler's sarcastic jokes, and Ross's love of facts, dinosaurs and complicated relationships. This quiz matches you with one of the six.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all six. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Warner Bros. or the show's creators; the names belong to their owners.

faq.a: Rachel Green, Monica Geller, Phoebe Buffay, Joey Tribbiani, Chandler Bing and Ross Geller.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Each character appears in eight answers and twice in every answer position, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Why are some characters always in the same question?
faq.a: Monica and Phoebe, Ross and Joey, and Chandler and Rachel are each other's opposites in these questions, so they always appear together and you choose between them.

rachel.name: Rachel Green
rachel.body: You are stylish, charming and braver than you look. You may have started out unsure of what you wanted, but you learned to stand on your own feet and chase a career you love. Friends come to you for advice on clothes and on life. Keep backing yourself; your instincts are better than you think.

monica.name: Monica Geller
monica.body: You are organized, caring and wonderfully competitive. You love hosting, you keep the group together and you like everything just right, with labels if possible. People rely on you because you always come through. Let yourself relax now and then; a little mess never hurt anyone.

phoebe.name: Phoebe Buffay
phoebe.body: You are a free spirit with your own way of seeing the world. You're honest, kind and gloriously weird, and you never pretend to be anyone else. Friends love that you say what others are too polite to say, and that you can find magic in ordinary days.

joey.name: Joey Tribbiani
joey.body: You are warm, loyal and easygoing, and you never share food. You may not have every answer, but you have a huge heart and you'd do anything for your friends. People feel good around you because you take life, and yourself, lightly.

chandler.name: Chandler Bing
chandler.body: You are quick, witty and the funniest person in most rooms. Jokes are how you handle awkward moments, and underneath them you are a deeply loyal and caring friend. Let people see the serious side too; they'll love it just as much.

ross.name: Ross Geller
ross.body: You are smart, curious and passionate about what you love, whether that's dinosaurs, history or a good argument about the rules. You care deeply and fall in love hard. Your friends know that under the facts there's a romantic who always tries his best.
